# CLI: VKS

Reads Kubernetes cluster inventory, versions, and quota. Only `hcm-3`
and `han-1` are supported. `--project-id` does not select a VKS workspace.
All three commands work under `--read-only`. Output contains account data.
See [VKS](VKS.md) for the SDK models and scope.

Every list prints `{"Items": [...]}`, so a `--query` starts with `Items`.

## get-quota

Kind: Read.

No fields.

```sh
vngcloud vks get-quota --query Quota
```

## list-cluster-versions

Kind: Read.

No fields.

```sh
vngcloud vks list-cluster-versions
```

## list-clusters

Kind: Read.

Pages start at 0, with a default size of 10. Each call reads one page.
Request the next page with `--page 1`. Use `--size` to set the page size.

| Flag | Type | Required |
|-|-|-|
| `--page` | `int` |  |
| `--size` | `int` |  |

```sh
vngcloud vks list-clusters \
  --query 'Items[].{ID:ID,Name:Name,Status:Status,Version:Version}' \
  --output table
```
